title: Junior Digital Marketing & Social Media Assistant Bootcamp
description: A hands-on, project-based course that builds the practical skills needed to launch a career as a digital marketing and social media assistant. Learners will run real ad campaigns, create engaging content, analyze performance data, and assemble a job-ready portfolio across paid ads, SEO, social media, and email marketing.
audience: Aspiring marketers, career changers, and recent graduates with little to no professional experience who want an entry-level digital marketing or social media role.

moduleTitles.2: Paid Advertising with Meta & Google Ads

targetRole: Junior Digital Marketing / Social Media Assistant
